comments.author: DirtehHippeh
comments.body_html:
I may be missing something, but the download link takes me to a 310 build zip. Is the most recent update not for 311?

I was running the 311 version but removed it when I started experiencing crashes mid-raid. The game would just go unresponsive and I would have to kill task. I had it happen five times in a row on 2 different maps. When I removed the mod, the crashing stopped. I figured I would wait for the next release and try again. But since I’m here, I thought I would share my experience.

I will admit this is completely anecdotal, as I don’t believe anyone else has reported similar issues. It could be a mod incompatibility causing it, a graphics setting, etc. I will say that when I build my mod stack, I add one at a time and test a playthrough to confirm stability before adding the next. This was the last mod I added.

I still want to thank you Somtam for this mod, as it did greatly improve my game performance while it was running.
